Give

Giving is an act of worship.

We believe we are all on ONE MISSION - to help people experience the extraordinary life in Christ.

The Bible teaches that giving is a part of growing in our faith. It is a response to God’s good gifts to us, and it is an act of worship toward Him. If Faith Baptist is your church home, or if the Lord has touched your heart about supporting His work at Faith, we hope this tool will help you to abound in the grace of giving.

Ministry Fund

A safe and secure way to give online

By clicking on the GIVE link, you will be able to set up an account and start making donations.

How does this giving platform work?

  • Register an online giving account or give anonymously.

  • Once you have created your online giving account, log in to our secure online giving form.

  • Give a single gift, or schedule recurring giving using your checking account, debit, or credit card.

Give online

“Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give… for God loveth a cheerful giver”

(2 Corinthians 9:7) However the Lord leads you to give, we are deeply grateful for your partnership in this ministry.

Ways to Give

Giving Challenge

The 60-Day Giving Challenge

The 60-Day Giving Challenge is an invitation for those who do not currently give to partner with God in their finances!

As followers of Christ, we believe we should place God first in every area of life -- including our finances. We also believe that God doesn’t want something from us, God wants something for us! God told the Children of Israel to prove Him, test Him in giving God the first and the best. He promised that if they did, they would see God’s blessing on their finances and over their lives.

Over the next 60 Days, we invite you to choose to TRUST God with your finances for the first time; to commit to giving 10% of your income according to the Bible and trusting God in this area!

What is the Faith Giving Challenge?

Giving is one of the most tangible ways we worship God because it declares He is first in our lives. This 60-day commitment to put God above material things is a huge step of faith and trust, and we couldn’t be more excited to hear how God works in your life as a result. *If participating in the challenge with your spouse, please fill out a form for each individual. This will ensure that all communication is received by each person.

Determine your tithe—10% of your income. If you can’t do 10%, perhaps start with 7% or with 5%, but ask God to bless you as you trust Him in this key area of growth.

Step One

Begin the next time you get paid (or the time after that). Just don’t wait long, as we have a great tendency to talk ourselves out of the steps God has for us. We strongly encourage you to auto give, so that way you know that step is being taken every time.

Step Two

Watch how God works in your finances and in your life. Keep track, keep a journal perhaps, but have a way where you can look back and see the Lord's blessing.

Step Three

Join the Giving Challenge
